title: refactor(Development/AbelianVarietyTheory/Proofs/InertiaEigenvalues): share Frobenius and Galois disc period proofs between Seed and WSeed
body:
Extracts the shared Frobenius matrix equation and Galois fixing-flat period identities from `Seed` and `WSeed` into generic lemmas over arbitrary disc period matrices `W`, eliminating the duplicated proofs in `FrobeniusMatrixRelationDiscrete.lean` and `SemistablePeriodsGaloisFixingFlat.lean`.

Declarations changed:
- Added `GlobalTheory.BSP.discPeriods_frobenius_eq_mul` in `CrystallineDiscPeriodsFrobeniusEqMul.lean` and delegated `GlobalTheory.BSP.Seed.crystallineDiscPeriods_frobenius_eq_mul` and `GlobalTheory.BKLim.WSeed.crystallineDiscPeriods_frobenius_eq_mul` (`FrobeniusMatrixRelationDiscrete.lean`) to it.
- Added `GlobalTheory.BSP.discPeriods_gal_eq` in `CrystallineDiscPeriodsGaloisActionEq.lean` and delegated `GlobalTheory.BSP.seed_gal_periods` and `GlobalTheory.BKLim.wseed_gal_periods` (`SemistablePeriodsGaloisFixingFlat.lean`) to it.
